name: tear ripple
source:
please see what i can't see. say the word that i can't say

a letter from me to you,

an answer from you to me

[From [url=https://dominoclub.itch.io/tear-ripple]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
请替我看看我所看不见的风景，替我说出我说不出口的话语。

一封由我寄给你的信，

一份由你回给我的答复。

[摘自[url=https://dominoclub.itch.io/tear-ripple]Itch.io[/url]]
